decisions.reason: Building on established glass-silicon capabilities, its performance likely meets the firm's aspirations, so it is retained.
As an incremental carrier-wafer line close to the core, results likely exceed aspirations and do not trigger problemistic search.
Although still uncertain, it is a flagship aligned with strategic direction, so slack is used to carry it while searching for further applications.
Off-the-shelf brand close to existing offer and presented as a focus is likely performing above aspiration, so it is kept.
Distant from the established wafer offer and not part of the stated direction, it likely falls short of aspirations, triggering search and release of resources.
